summary: Glacier lookout site at Goat Haunt: photographed from in 1935; the NPS overlook trail now ends at a former fire lookout site.

facts.status_note: NPS describes the Goat Haunt Overlook trail as ending at the site of a former fire lookout. No source says the tower stands.

access.note: NPS lists a short, steep trail to the overlook. The page describes no closure.

visit.trail_note: A short, steep trail ends at the site of the former lookout and a view of the Waterton Valley.

events.note: Panoramic photographs taken from Goat Haunt Mt. on 8/12/1935 by L. Moe, on infrared and panchromatic film, per the NPS table. The Montana index notes panorama photos on the same date.

notes_for_editor: No build date and no removal date were found for the Goat Haunt lookout. The NPS overlook page calls the trail's end a former fire lookout, and the 1935 NPS table names a Goat Haunt Mt. station, but no source ties the two together. The 1935 date comes from two sources. The ELO label in the Montana index is not expanded in any source checked. Consider a second search for a Glacier lookout history (Lester Moe 1935 survey) before publishing. The Great Falls Tribune article on Glacier lookouts returned HTTP 403 and was not read.
